notes.title: 1.0.2Update
notes.content:
Happy New Year to all of you who have taken an interest in my game.
- Countermeasure for the problem of player going through the wall.
- Enhanced countermeasures against the problem of progressively heavier processing as the game continues.(The measures have been strengthened since the last time.)

notes.title: 1.0.1Update
notes.content:
- Fixed a problem in which some processing of the double-speed function was much faster than expected.(With this, the play feel during double speed will be balanced differently than before. Our apologies.)
- Enhanced countermeasures against the problem of progressively heavier processing as the game continues.
